svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Two hosts. VM A on host 1 sends to VM B on host 2. The VM hook wraps the packet for wg0. WireGuard encrypts it and sends it over the provider private network. Host 2 decrypts it and its WireGuard hook unwraps it for VM B.
